title: Marguerite and the Cipher Revisited
author: Isandro Blackwood
blurb: Rafael Hartwell, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
